# Review #358: revise

Reviewer model family: OpenAI GPT; author: Claude Sonnet. This verdict uses the staged evidence, including earlier Claude and GPT review work.
Reviewed HEAD: `a25baf58543cae71a6cf3961bea35823b1753bcf`; runner and manifest hashes match issue #352 (`f5f1b174…`, `4d4c2b0f…`). Commit `f405d54` is unavailable locally, so its complete diff remains unverified.

## Standards
No blocking Standards findings in the inspected files; no AGENTS.md files were found. Repository product files were not edited.

## Spec
1. **Blocking:** [runner_contract.py:207](../benchmark/scripts/runner_contract.py#L207) has no effective regression control for its expected-reason comparison: deleting that comparison makes `--check` exit **0**, contrary to this issue's acceptance criterion. Fix: add a self-test that invokes `expect_reject` with deliberately different actual and expected reasons and requires the specific mismatch error; fail if it returns normally. Re-run the deletion probe and require nonzero exit.
Independent scripted manifest comparison passed: 62 fields, no missing/extras, 43 exact template null reasons, and 19 populated values carrying synthetic provenance.
The plan matches [protocol.md:79–83](../benchmark/protocol.md#L79): three synthetic cases × two arms × two repetitions, with deterministic seeded hash ordering within each pair; these counts establish no real precision plan.
`run_record.py` matches its pinned SHA256 `b39c3060…`; it is imported directly at [runner_contract.py:25](../benchmark/scripts/runner_contract.py#L25), and both `validate` and `bind_manifest` are called inside the per-record audit loop at lines 171–172.
Baseline `python3 -I -B benchmark/scripts/runner_contract.py --check` exited 0, reporting 12 planned records and 10 rejected mutations; no actual benchmark runs occurred.
Temporary-copy probes: removed reason comparison **0 (FAIL)**; ignored missing run **1 (PASS)**; accepted foreign-manifest binding **1 (PASS)**; changed one manifest byte **1 (PASS)**. Exact outputs: [probe evidence](artifacts/review-358-probes.json).
[runner-contract.md:3](../benchmark/baseline/runner-contract.md#L3) explicitly states design only, no runs, no readiness, tool quality unmeasured, and open resource rows #169/#268. No evaluator changes or semantic quality claims were endorsed.

## What next
Policymaker: defer pinning, order the fix for finding 1, then independently repeat all four probes. Evidence is saved above; do not repeat startup reads, manifest comparison or unrelated source inspection. If full commit provenance is required, stage the #352 commit/diff; the history manifest currently contains no records. This review establishes neither benchmark readiness nor goal completion.
